All three Python module workers exited with ModuleNotFoundError before inference because PYTHONPATH was absent. Restart uses the same hashed code and PYTHONPATH=src. Prior registry/logs are retained.

rendering_repairs: Local Matplotlib 3.1 requires constrained_layout=True instead of layout=constrained and full six-digit hexadecimal colors. Figure-only changes leave model calculations unchanged.
